title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Allowance for the Account's Call Volume at Review
content:
| Calls dispatched in the window | Emergency dispatches counted in it | The allowance added |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 2 or more | 15000 US dollars |
| 12 or more | fewer than 2 | 7500 US dollars |
| 6 to 11 | any | 7500 US dollars |
| fewer than 6 | any | no allowance is added for the account's call volume |

The calls dispatched and the emergency dispatches counted are those standing on the rate program under
the Demand Service Rate Programs within the window the review reads.

**Both sides of the counts (hypothetical).** An account with 12 calls dispatched in the window and 2
emergency dispatches counted in it takes the allowance of 15000 US dollars. The same 12 calls with a
single emergency dispatch take 7500 US dollars, the call count standing at 6 or more. An account with 5
calls dispatched takes no allowance for call volume, whatever its emergency dispatches.
